description: This file contains implementation for managing Git worktrees including functions for creating, freeing, validating, and repairing worktree structures, managing linked and main worktrees, and handling related configuration and filesystem operations.

classes.name: struct worktree
classes.description: Represents a Git worktree with associated metadata such as path, ID, reference info, and status flags.

methods.name: void free_worktree(struct worktree * worktree)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a worktree structure.

methods.name: void free_worktrees(struct worktree ** worktrees)
methods.description: Frees memory for an array of worktree structures.

methods.name: void add_head_info(struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Populates the worktree's head_oid, head_ref, and is_detached based on the ref store.

methods.name: int is_current_worktree(struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Checks if the given worktree is the current one in the repository.

methods.name: int is_main_worktree_bare(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Determines if the main worktree repository is bare, considering configuration overrides.

methods.name: struct:worktree * get_main_worktree(int skip_reading_head)
methods.description: Retrieves the main worktree associated with the repository.

methods.name: struct:worktree * get_linked_worktree(const char * id,int skip_reading_head)
methods.description: Retrieves a linked secondary worktree by its ID.

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees_internal(int skip_reading_head)
methods.description: Internal function to list all worktrees (main and linked), optionally skipping head information.

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees(void)
methods.description: Returns all worktrees, reading head info.

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees_without_reading_head(void)
methods.description: Returns all worktrees without reading head info.

methods.name: char * get_worktree_git_dir(const struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Gets the git directory path for a worktree, considering if it's main or linked.

methods.name: struct:worktree * find_worktree_by_suffix(struct worktree ** list,const char * suffix)
methods.description: Finds a worktree in the list ending with the specified suffix.

methods.name: struct:worktree * find_worktree(struct worktree ** list,const char * prefix,const char * arg)
methods.description: Finds a worktree by prefix or path.

methods.name: struct:worktree * find_worktree_by_path(struct worktree ** list,const char * p)
methods.description: Finds a worktree matching the given filesystem path.

methods.name: int is_main_worktree(const struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Checks if the given worktree is the main one (no ID).

methods.name: const char * worktree_lock_reason(struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Returns the reason why a worktree is locked.

methods.name: const char * worktree_prune_reason(struct worktree * wt,timestamp_t expire)
methods.description: Returns the reason for pruning a worktree, if applicable.

methods.name: int validate_worktree(const struct worktree * wt,struct strbuf * errmsg,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Validates the integrity and correctness of a worktree structure.

methods.name: void update_worktree_location(struct worktree * wt,const char * path_,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Relocates the worktree to a new filesystem path.

methods.name: int is_worktree_being_rebased(const struct worktree * wt,const char * target)
methods.description: Checks if the worktree is currently rebasing.

methods.name: int is_worktree_being_bisected(const struct worktree * wt,const char * target)
methods.description: Checks if the worktree is currently bisecting.

methods.name: int is_shared_symref(const struct worktree * wt,const char * symref,const char * target)
methods.description: Determines if the ref is shared among worktrees via symref.

methods.name: const struct worktree * find_shared_symref(struct worktree ** worktrees,const char * symref,const char * target)
methods.description: Finds a worktree that shares the given symref.

methods.name: int submodule_uses_worktrees(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a submodule path uses worktrees.

methods.name: void strbuf_worktree_ref(const struct worktree * wt,struct strbuf * sb,const char * refname)
methods.description: Appends the correct ref prefix for a worktree.

methods.name: int other_head_refs(each_ref_fn fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterates over non-current worktrees' HEAD refs, calling a callback.

methods.name: void repair_gitfile(struct worktree * wt,worktree_repair_fn fn,void * cb_data,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Repairs or updates the .git file of a worktree if broken or inconsistent.

methods.name: void repair_noop(int iserr UNUSED,const char * path UNUSED,const char * msg UNUSED,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: A no-operation callback used during repair procedures.

methods.name: void repair_worktrees(worktree_repair_fn fn,void * cb_data,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Repairs all worktrees' gitlink files.

methods.name: void repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move(struct worktree * wt,const char * old_path)
methods.description: Fixes gitdir links after moving a worktree.

methods.name: void repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move(const char * old_path)
methods.description: Fixes all worktrees' gitdir links after repository move.

methods.name: void repair_worktree_at_path(const char * path,worktree_repair_fn fn,void * cb_data,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Repairs the gitdir linkage for a specific worktree path.

methods.name: int should_prune_worktree(const char * id,struct strbuf * reason,char ** wtpath,timestamp_t expire)
methods.description: Determines if a worktree should be pruned based on its gitdir status and age.

methods.name: int init_worktree_config(struct repository * r)
methods.description: Initializes worktree-specific configuration in the repository.

methods.name: void write_worktree_linking_files(struct strbuf dotgit,struct strbuf gitdir,int use_relative_paths)
methods.description: Creates or updates the linking files (.git and gitdir) for a worktree.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
